reason: A dsh web-search provider that routes queries across free GitHub, arXiv, StackExchange, Hacker News, Tavily, and Sogou engines with fallback handling and normalized results.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多源网页搜索，通过多个免费或可选密钥的搜索引擎检索并返回统一结果。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with multi-source web search using several free or optionally keyed search engines and normalized results.

capabilities: Performs external web searches through multiple search and content APIs
Sends user queries to third-party search services
Optionally uses the TAVILY_API_KEY environment variable for Tavily requests
Replaces the default dsh web search provider with this provider
